title: Rubio Navarrete to Joaquín Téllez, 14 and 15 Oct 1913: two federal telegrams in the División del Bravo syllabary (CEHM DLXXIII), decoded, not read

plaintext.source: Typed telegram, clear Spanish with numerical passages; no contemporary decipherment.
Handwritten telegram, clear Spanish with numerical passages; no contemporary decipherment.

system.summary: Numerical syllabary (numbers 1-255 for letters, syllables and a few words) set in the clear text; table rebuilt here from pencil glosses

prior_solution.where: Not in the repository before 22 Nov 2026, the Tomokiyo index, or R. Narváez's 2015 and 2025 articles. Narváez, Criptografía diplomática, política y militar en México 1813-1926 (SRE, 2019), checked 21-22 Nov 2026 from photographs of a loan copy (chapters VII-XI, pp. 261-410, and the index, pp. 487-495): it prints neither the telegram(s) nor the key.

conditions.human_role: Andrew Beling chose the target, set the rules (frozen plans, blind transcriptions, controls) and photographed the Narváez book; AI agents transcribed, rebuilt and tested the key and wrote up.
models: AI agents run by Andrew Beling; the model of each step is not recorded in the work files (Claude Opus 5.5, Anthropic, for the 22 Nov 2026 steps)

solution.what: Table rebuilt from the pencil glosses of the 19 Jul 1913 draft (DLXXIII.1.30.17-49) and the 8 Oct 1913 telegram (DLXXIII.1.32.3-41); 71 entries frozen (candidate.tsv).
Original 26 July values on the held-out 14 Oct telegram: 17/53 groups, beat 667/1,000 shuffles.
71-entry table on the held-out 14 Oct telegram: 43/53 groups, beat 999/1,000 shuffles; complete words la, Laredo, de, esa, plaza, tren, en.
15 Oct telegram transcribed by two blind AI readers; 98 of 104 positions agreed, six kept unknown.
78-entry table (71 plus seven values from 14 Oct) on the held-out 15 Oct telegram: 76/104 groups, beat 1,000/1,000 shuffles; the seven additions tested alone beat 984/1,000 (miss).
Narváez 2019, chapters VII-XI and index, checked from photographs: no reading and no matching table.

Frozen test of the limantour1909 key, the Villa key of open PR 865 and Jalkut's two-digit card (duron1911): the first two cover too few groups; the card beat at most 542/1,000; void for October because the positive control failed the plan's word criterion.
Strict count (every letter from a tested value): 14 Oct 7/16 words, 15 Oct 3/29 (7/29 with the untested additions).

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The table was rebuilt from pencil syllables written over the groups of a July 1913 draft and from an 8 Oct 1913 telegram with its clear text, frozen, and tested on the two held-out telegrams.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Cipher words with every letter from a tested value: 14 Oct 7/16, 15 Oct 3/29; 10/45 together.

gaps.detail: groups 20, 53, 108, 113, 132, 140, 147 without a tested value; one illegible group
28 of 104 groups without a value; the additions that would complete four words failed their test

credits.note: with AI agents: table rebuilt and tested; two telegrams transcribed and decoded
rubio1913: identified the 1-255 syllabary traffic and the July pencil draft as unread

texts.label: 14 Oct 1913, Rubio to Téllez (DLXXIII.1.32.5-41)
texts.summary: Railway and telegraph cut; asks for another repair train from Laredo.

texts.label: 15 Oct 1913, Rubio to [Téllez] (DLXXIII.1.32.6-41)
texts.summary: The line is destroyed; relief of a detachment; too few words read for more.
